summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: On `npm install`, the `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which fetches a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the shipped `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses obfuscator.io-style identifier mangling with dispatcher objects wrapping the fetch/unzip/execFileSync calls, and `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, string-array-rotation bundle with no readable identifiers, URLs, or strings. The filename `math_init.js` does not correspond to any documented functionality of the package (advertised as a small MCP/IDW adapter, with dist code on the order of kilobytes) and the Bun runtime is not required by that stated purpose. The obfuscation of the wrapper around a runtime-download-and-execute pattern conceals the eventual payload's behavior from anyone auditing the tarball, and execution is automatic on default install so any developer or CI installing the package runs the concealed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
